title: unified-rollouts-enhance-canary-shadow-auto-rollback-observability
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Implements enhancements to the unified rollouts controller to support staged weighted canaries with integrated shadow probing and metric-driven automatic rollback. This PR introduces a new probing stage that sends shadow traffic to candidate variants for targeted sampling and improved signal quality, extends the rollout policy DSL to express weighted canary stages and composite metric thresholds, tightens observability by emitting new rollout-level telemetry and tracing spans, and adds e2e stability guards and integration tests. The patch also updates the Redwood Console rollout editor to expose new stage options and threshold presets, and adds documentation and examples for common workflows. Motivation: previous rollout runs showed noisy shadow signals and slow detection of regressions in A/B scenarios. The new probing + metric quorum model reduces false positives and improves rollback time while preserving safe canary exposure. This description is intentionally continuous and single-line to match PR export conventions.

notes_for_ops: When deploying to Dedicated/Private clusters consider increasing probe timeout for high latency regions. Charts include rollout probe timeout and default thresholds under charts.redwood.values.rolloutProbe. Monitor rollout_probe_loss_rate and rollout_level_probe_latency metrics during initial rollout after upgrade.
